collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager has one line of a children's song stuck in their head: sing it out loud, or try to think of a different song.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Since waking up, (subject) has had a song stuck in (subject.his/her) head. Just one line of it, from a song the children were singing yesterday. "The crab goes sideways, sideways, sideways." Over and over. All morning. (subject.He/she) can't get rid of it. (friend) is working beside (subject.him/her).

choices.label: Try to Think of a Different Song

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) sings it out loud, hoping that will help. It doesn't. Worse, (friend) now has it too. By lunch they are both singing it, sideways, sideways, sideways, and so are two people working nearby. By evening it has spread through half the village. Nobody can remember the rest of the song.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) tries singing a different song in (subject.his/her) head to push the crab out. It works, briefly. Then the two songs get tangled, and now the crab is going sideways to a completely different tune. (subject) groans. (friend) asks what's wrong. "Don't ask," says (subject). "You'll catch it."
